name: dbrd
revision_note: Sentiment (2 groups) is the coarse level and rating (1,2,4,5 stars) the fine level of a nested hierarchy. DBRD is where the length confound was first seen: the naive chi-square screen ranked word and character count above sentiment and rating.

sentiment.why: Positive or negative review: very different vocabulary.

review_id.why: File name of the review; arbitrary.
